name: FreeUPI Payment Gateway for UPI
author: freeupi

sections.description:
FreeUPI Payment Gateway for UPI is a powerful plugin that allows WooCommerce stores to accept UPI payments seamlessly. By integrating with the FreeUPI API, this plugin ensures secure and efficient payment processing. Customers can pay using any UPI-enabled app, making the checkout process smooth and user-friendly.

Key features:
– Supports all UPI apps that comply with the UPI standard.
– Provides real-time payment status updates.
– Easy configuration through the WooCommerce settings panel.
– No transaction fees charged by FreeUPI.

This plugin is ideal for WooCommerce store owners looking to offer a modern and convenient payment method to their customers.

Short Description

FreeUPI Payment Gateway for UPI enables WooCommerce stores to accept secure and fast UPI payments using the FreeUPI API, enhancing the checkout experience.

External Services

This plugin connects to the FreeUPI API to create and manage payment orders.
– Data sent: Order details (amount, order ID, etc.)
– Data received: Payment status and transaction details
– Service provider: FreeUPI (https://freeupi.com)
– Terms of Service: https://freeupi.com/terms
– Privacy Policy: https://freeupi.com/privacy

Video Guide

📺 Watch Setup Video

Support

For support, please visit https://freeupi.com/support or contact us via email at info@freeupi.com.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/freeupi-payment-gateway-for-upi directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Configure the plugin settings in WooCommerce > Settings > Payments.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin support all UPI apps?

Yes, this plugin supports all UPI apps that comply with the UPI standard.

Is there any transaction fee?

No, FreeUPI does not charge any transaction fees for using this plugin.

How do I report an issue?

Please use the support section below to report any issues.

is it working for non-indian website?

No its will not work for non-indian websites.
